Struct Segment

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.SegmentDef

ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a 2D line segment defined by a start and end point, with a calculated normal.

public readonly struct Segment : IEquatable<Segment>, IShapeTypeProvider

ApplyOffset(Transform2D, float)
